responsibility: Supplies the MinGW target’s fixed-width integer type definitions used when GCC synthesizes `<stdint.h>`-related builtin type macros. It maps exact-, least-, and fast-width integer types plus `sig_atomic_t` and pointer-sized integer types to the MinGW/MS ABI data model, including the special pointer-width choice for AArch64 MS ABI versus 32/64-bit x86 Windows targets.
